takeaway: Cystic fibrosis is an autosomal recessive disease from a CFTR mutation on chromosome 7, the most common inherited disease in Caucasians.

question.say: With regard to cystic fibrosis, which statement is true?

answer.text: It is the most common inherited disease in Caucasians
answer.say: The answer: it is the most common inherited disease in Caucasians.

lines.text: The sticky mucus child holds the trophy.
lines.say: (laugh) The sticky mucus child proudly holds the trophy of cystic fibrosis.

lines.text: The trophy says: most common inherited.
lines.say: The trophy says it all. Cystic fibrosis is the most common inherited disease in Caucasians.
It affects one in two thousand five hundred children.

lines.text: A worker fixes chromosome 7: the CFTR mutation.
lines.say: The worker repairs chromosome seven, where the CFTR gene is mutated. It is autosomal recessive.

lines.text: Carriers may be more resistant to cholera.
lines.say: Carriers are believed to be relatively more resistant to cholera.

lines.text: Remember: cystic fibrosis is the most common inherited disease in Caucasians.
